diagnostics.title: Check tunnel · {name}
diagnostics.hint: The check only reads the network. A password is never sent and the result is not stored.
diagnostics.disabled: Check tunnel is off in Settings → Features.
diagnostics.summary_ok: Nothing obvious is wrong. If the tunnel still fails to start, open the last error on its status row.
diagnostics.summary_error: {count} checks did not pass. Below is what is getting in the way.
diagnostics.summary_password: The network answers. This check does not send the password: only a real connection uses it.

checks.dns_miss: {host} did not resolve. Check the jump host address.
checks.dns_timeout: The name server did not answer for {host}.
checks.dns_literal: {host} is already an IP address, so a name lookup is unnecessary.
checks.dns_empty: The jump host has no address.
checks.dns_no_jumper: No jump host is selected, so there is no name to look up.
checks.tcp_ok_chain: The first jump host {addr} accepts a connection. Later hops are reached only through it.
checks.tcp_empty: The jump host has no address.
checks.tcp_bad: Jump host port {port} is not valid.
checks.tcp_no_jumper: No jump host is selected, so there is no port to reach.
checks.tcp_refused: {addr} is closed: nothing is listening there.
checks.listen_free: Local port {addr} is free, so the tunnel can bind it.
checks.listen_self: Port {addr} is held by this tunnel. That is expected while it is running.
checks.listen_other: Port {addr} is already used by the tunnel “{name}”.
checks.listen_busy: Port {addr} is used by another program. Pick another local port or stop that program.
checks.listen_remote: This is a remote tunnel: it does not listen on a local port.
checks.listen_error: Local port {addr} could not be checked.
checks.auth_hostkey: The host key for {host} does not match known_hosts. The machine may have changed, or this may be a different server.
checks.auth_timeout: The SSH server {host} did not finish login in time.
checks.auth_key_missing_empty: Key login has no key file.
checks.auth_key_encrypted: Key {file} is protected by a passphrase, and that passphrase did not work.
checks.auth_prefix_ok: The key for {user} at {host} was accepted. The next host {next} uses a password, which this check does not send.
checks.auth_skipped_password: The password for {host} was not sent. This check only tries a key or the agent.
checks.auth_skipped_down: Not checked: the jump host cannot be reached.
checks.auth_no_jumper: This tunnel has no jump host.
checks.auth_no_host: The jump host has no address, so login cannot be checked.
checks.auth_banner_bad: {addr} is open, but it is not SSH.
checks.latency_skipped: Not checked: the host does not answer.
checks.target_refused: SSH works, but {addr} is closed on the far side.
checks.target_timeout: SSH works, but {addr} did not answer on the far side.
checks.target_unreachable: SSH works, but there is no route to {addr} on the far side.
checks.target_denied: The SSH server refused to forward traffic to {addr}.
checks.target_bad: The destination address is not valid.
checks.target_skipped_dynamic: Not checked: a SOCKS tunnel has no single destination.
checks.target_skipped_auth: Not checked: SSH login must succeed first.
checks.target_skipped_down: Not checked: the jump host cannot be reached.
checks.target_local_refused: Nothing on this computer is listening on {addr}. The remote tunnel forwards to that address.
checks.target_local_timeout: {addr} on this computer did not answer in time.
checks.target_local_error: {addr} on this computer cannot be reached.

portSwitch.message: Stop “{oldName}” and start “{newName}”? Local port {port} can only listen once.

importTunnel.title: Import tunnels
importTunnel.sshCommandPlaceholder:
Paste one or more ssh commands...
ssh -N -L 3000:127.0.0.1:3000 -J jump{'@'}bastion user{'@'}dev-host
importTunnel.hint: Passwords and other secrets from the command line are not stored. An alias from ~/.ssh/config is filled in when it exists.
importTunnel.nothing: The command has no tunnels to create.
importTunnel.nameInvalid: A name is required and must be at most {max} characters.

warnings.missing_target: The command has no destination host.
warnings.ignored_secret: A secret from the command line is not stored ({option}).
warnings.not_ssh: The line is not an ssh command and was skipped.
warnings.duplicate_existing: This tunnel already exists and was left unselected.
warnings.duplicate_batch: This tunnel is repeated in the paste and the copy was left unselected.

importTunnel.defaultMatchedJumper: A matching jump host is selected by default.
importTunnel.warningInvalidTarget: Found a token with {'@'}, but it is not a valid user{'@'}host.
importTunnel.warningMissingTarget: No valid user{'@'}host; import is blocked.
importTunnel.errorDuplicateExisting: This tunnel already exists: same route and jump host.
importTunnel.errorDuplicateBatch: This parse already has a tunnel with the same route and jump host.
importTunnel.errorMissingTarget: The SSH command has no valid user{'@'}host; import is blocked.

importJumper.title: Import jump hosts
importJumper.emptyDesc: Add explicit Host aliases to ~/.ssh/config and load again.
importJumper.warningAgentFallback: IdentityFile was not found. SSH Agent will be used.
importJumper.errorMissingUser: SSH config has no User. Add it before importing.
importJumper.errorMissingHost: SSH config has no HostName or target host.
importJumper.errorProxyJump: This alias uses ProxyJump ({proxyJump}). Create the jump host chain manually for now.
importJumper.errorDuplicateExisting: A jump host with the same user, host, and port already exists.
importJumper.errorDuplicateBatch: This host is duplicated in the current import.

config.languageDesc: Auto follows the system language: Russian for ru, English otherwise
config.simpleOnTopDesc: Keep the compact window above other windows
config.autoRunDesc: Launch Norka when you sign in
config.trafficMonitorDesc: Show speed and a traffic chart in the sidebar
config.checkUpdatesDesc: Look for a new version on GitHub at startup and once a day
config.quickSearchDesc: The shortcut opens the palette above every window, even when Norka is hidden to the tray. Ctrl+K still works inside the window.
config.quickSearchDisabled: Quick search is off in Features. The palette and the global shortcut stay idle.
config.quickSearchInvalid: That shortcut does not work: it needs a modifier and a key.
config.quickSearchUnsupported: A global hotkey cannot be registered on this system. Ctrl+K still works inside the window.
config.manageConfigDesc: Export, import, or open the configuration folder
config.includePasswordsDesc: Write jump host passwords into the export file
config.includePasswordsWarning: The file will contain passwords in plain text. Do not send it or leave it where others can read it.
config.notificationsDesc: Notifications are off by default. After you turn them on, Norka reports a drop, a reconnect, giving up, and a failed connect. A successful connect stays off. Stopping a tunnel yourself does not notify. Several events a couple of seconds apart are combined, for example “3 tunnels reconnected”.
config.notificationsMasterDesc: System notifications, including when the window is hidden to the tray
config.notifyDroppedDesc: The connection dropped and reconnecting has started
config.notifyReconnectedDesc: The link is back after a drop
config.notifyConnectFailedDesc: Starting the tunnel ended with an error
config.notifyConnectedDesc: A successful start. Off by default, so it does not get in the way
config.secretsOk: Passwords and key passphrases live in the system keychain. config.toml keeps only a reference.
config.secretsUnavailable: The keychain is unavailable. Passwords stay in config.toml, as before. On Windows and macOS they are moved to Credential Manager or Keychain.
config.configDirUnavailable: Could not read the path (the backend may be unavailable).
config.configDirRelocateConfirm:
Copy the configuration to the selected folder and switch to it? Active tunnels will stop. The app will quit — start it again.

{dir}
config.configDirConflictPrompt:
{dir}

This folder already has configuration files. Overwrite them or keep the existing ones?
config.configDirResetConfirm: Copy the configuration back to the default folder and remove the redirect? The app will quit — start it again.
config.configDirResetImplicitMissing: Could not determine the default configuration folder.
config.configDirRelocateQuitHint: Configuration updated. The app will quit; a packaged build usually restarts in a second. In wails dev, start it again yourself.
config.importSuccess: Configuration imported. Autostart tunnels were restarted.
config.importConfirm: The current configuration will be overwritten. Active tunnels will stop and restart. Continue?
config.diagnosticsCollectDesc: Saves a zip for a bug report: version, log, tunnel state, and statistics. Passwords, keys, and tokens are left out.
config.diagnosticsIncludeHostsDesc: Off by default: addresses and usernames are replaced with ***.

features.title: Features
features.profilesDesc: Page, sidebar item, header chip, simple-mode switcher, and tray submenu. Turning this off keeps saved profiles and leaves running tunnels alone.
features.quickSearchDesc: The Ctrl+K palette and the global shortcut.
features.notificationsDesc: System notifications for a drop, a reconnect, and connection errors.
features.autoUpdateDesc: Check for a new version at startup and install it in one click.
features.trafficMonitorDesc: Speed and a traffic chart in the sidebar.
features.mascotDesc: Idle motion and a hidden Easter egg.
features.sshCommandDesc: Paste an ssh command to create a tunnel, and copy a tunnel back out as a command.
features.wakeReconnectDesc: After wake or a network change, probe SSH immediately and restore tunnels without waiting for keepalive.
features.automationDesc: Terminal commands and norka:// links. Off by default: this is a local control surface for tunnels.
features.tunnelStatsDesc: Connected time, reconnects, the last error, and traffic for each tunnel.
features.onboardingDesc: A short introduction while the tunnel list is empty.
features.diagnosticsDesc: The Collect diagnostics button in Settings and the tray item. A bug-report archive without passwords or keys.
features.tunnelDiagnosticsDesc: DNS, the jump host port, key login, and a free local port, from the tunnel menu. On by default: it helps explain a failed connection. A password is never sent and nothing is stored.

onboarding.welcomeBody: I keep SSH tunnels up and show their status with my eyes. Here is a short look at where to start.
onboarding.addBody: The New tunnel button on the Tunnels page creates the first connection.
onboarding.addSsh: You can paste a ready ssh -L … command: Import → From an SSH command.
onboarding.eyesBody: Both eyes are always the same color. The tray icon uses that color too.
onboarding.trayBody: The tray icon uses the same color as the eyes. Open the window again from the tray.
onboarding.trayQuick: Quick search opens with Ctrl+K and with the global shortcut, even when the window is hidden.
onboarding.featuresBody: Settings → Features turns extra capabilities on and off. This tour is one of them.
